|The **Tokenize API** endpoint facilitates the creation of various TMS tokens such as Customers, Payment Instruments, Shipping Addresses, and Instrument Identifiers in a single operation. The request includes a processingInformation object, which specifies **"TOKEN_CREATE"** and the types of tokens to be created.
